request.task: T0 closure Canvas Agent Studio audit scope, authority cage, and baseline
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

findings.scenario: T0 claims to byte-bind the complete `Local Canvas and API surface` slice of `docs/specs/2026-08-29-ai-teammate-foundation-v1.md` at commit `899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0`, but the only locator is prose (“bytes from that heading up to but not including `Security and data boundary`”) plus a SHA-256. Unlike the A/B/G/M rows, this omits byte count, `git show <full-commit>:<path>`, encoding, no-newline-normalization, heading-marker inclusivity (`## ` vs title text), and whether blank lines before the next heading are in-range. Two legal extracts (off-by-LF / heading-prefix) can be formed; only one can match the digest. That is not an exact source/extraction rule for the primary audit object.
findings.remediation: Bind the section the same way as the criterion rows: `git show 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0:docs/specs/2026-08-29-ai-teammate-foundation-v1.md` with no newline normalization; define a half-open UTF-8 range from the first byte of the exact heading line through the byte immediately before the next heading line; publish that byte count with the existing SHA-256; state whether the following heading’s preceding LFs are included.

findings.scenario: The md/JSON present the zsh failure as the same focused suite with an unquoted `[id]` glob. The recorded `invalidInvocation.command` also inserts `src/components/preview/AiTeammate/LocalAiTeammatePanel.tsx` (a non-test source file absent from the successful shell:false argv). Even with quoting, that command is not the baseline argv; stderr is plain text without byte count/SHA-256/base64.
findings.remediation: Record the failed invocation as the exact same argv as the successful run, joined only for the shell demonstration; keep `baselineEvidence: false`; if a source path was actually passed, say so instead of attributing the failure solely to globbing.

audit.proof_assessment: Run 1 decoded preimage is 247 bytes and contains the stated 17/29/21 counts and authority packet SHA-256 `f17059ecbf094c89ace92f1b415f0bf5a695f8893feec3a0843dd9eedd50aa51`. Run 3 decoded preimage is 698 bytes and matches 8 files / 37 tests, shell:false argv with literal `[id]`, cwd, exit 0. Empty stderr digests match SHA-256(""). Run 2 padding (`9179 % 3 == 2`, single `=`) is consistent; TAP summary 48/48 matches the md. Cage lists read/propose, a closed path/prefix set, and a prohibited-capability list, and separates audit dependencies from implementation authorization. A/B/G/M rows and full upgrade/index include bytes+SHA-256 and row extraction rules. Non-empty transcript SHA-256s and all spec/tree digests were not recomputed here.
residual_risks: Spec, tree, and criterion-row SHA-256s cannot be checked without git objects at 899b394/7a1a54e4.
OBX-AUTH-ATF-001 is not in the slice, so cage completeness vs the authorizing record is unproven.
test:plans / vitest transcripts embed timings; SHA-256s are recomputable only from the stored base64, not by re-running.
Full foundation-spec digest has no byte count or git-show/newline rule.
Per-path effects are stated globally (read/propose), not per allowed path.
